theorems.name: Submission.rpn_compact_null_of_le_mul_diff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (U K : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (C : ℝ≥0), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → μ W < ∞) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → μ W ≤ (C : ℝ≥0∞) * μ (W \ K)) → μ K = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
